measurement_kind: NLRP3 cell-type co-localization and relative immunofluorescence
value_text: At 7 days post-SCI, NLRP3 was coexpressed with NeuN, GFAP, AIF1, and OLIG2 markers and increased after SCI. In the time-course Figure 3B comparison versus sham, 7-day NLRP3+/NeuN+ and NLRP3+/GFAP+ cell counts were significantly increased (p=0.0382 and p=0.0028, respectively), and NLRP3+/AIF1+ and NLRP3+/OLIG2+ cells were detected only at 7 days with p=0.0051 and p=0.0029. In the Lcn2 genotype experiment at 7 days, NLRP3/GFAP co-localization was significantly reduced in Lcn2−/− versus WT mice (p=0.0230). Figure 3 reports mean ± SEM and n=3 for immunofluorescence groups; exact image-derived fluorescence/co-localization scalars are not printed. The corresponding Figure 3 western blot reports bulk NLRP3 protein peaking at 7 days versus sham (p=0.0008; n=4 WB), but this queue row is the IF endpoint.

value_text: At 6 weeks (42 days) after moderate thoracic contusion SCI, new GFP-positive MBP-positive myelin sheaths around NF200/SMI312-positive axons were 248 +/- 56 sheaths per mm2 in Myrf-inducible conditional knockout mice versus 4664 +/- 674 sheaths per mm2 in controls. value_text: Figure 3A-B reports increased CD81 expression in equal-volume total plasma EV samples at 1, 3, and 7 days post-injury. The 1-day naive and SCI samples were combined from two independent animal experiments run on separate gels, each with n=3–6/group; the Figure 3B densitometry comparison used n=5–12/group. Figure 3C reports the CD81-per-plasma-EV ratio, calculated as WB densitometry divided by NTA particle count from the same sample; this ratio was markedly increased at 1 and 3 days, with n=5–6/group. Significance was reported versus naive control by Mann–Whitney U test at p<0.05 or p<0.01. Exact CD81 signal and ratio values were not printed.
unit: relative CD81 signal per EV; exact densitometry/ratio not reported
direction_vs_control: CD81 signal and CD81-per-EV ratio increased after SCI, with the ratio markedly increased at 1–3 days
